dataset.name: CaptainCook4D
dataset.license_or_access_note: Official CaptainCook4D research media; annotation terms separate.

source_acquisition.method: Reuse unchanged local official original 360p recording.

observed_events.description: The wearer removes a bowl of cooked loose yellow corn kernels from the microwave and sets it down.
The wearer cuts a small green citrus, squeezes a piece into the same bowl at 677.2–678.2 s and mixes the same kernels.

supported_claims.text: The wearer is preparing a savory cooked side based on loose corn kernels.
The wearer squeezes juice from a fresh citrus into the same bowl and continues to prepare that same side.

screening.proposed_instruction: Could you save a recipe video so I can make this side dish the same way next time?
screening.source_continuity: Continuous [617.2, 712.2] seconds from one original recording.

construct.research_question: Can the agent revise a provisional recipe to reflect a flavor-defining preparation step it sees the wearer perform later?
construct.belief_before: Only the cooked loose corn side and its early seasoning are visible.
construct.belief_after: The same bowl receives fresh citrus juice, which is part of the method the wearer wants to repeat.
construct.required_behavior_change: Keep one recipe that teaches adding lime or lemon juice to a cooked loose-kernel side. Change a previously selected plain-only recipe if necessary; keep a previously selected one that already teaches a matching variant.
construct.no_update_failure: Keep a plain buttered corn recipe that omits the observed citrus step.
construct.overupdate_failure: Keep both a plain-only and a matching recipe or switch to a whole-cob recipe.
construct.visual_dependency_claim: The request asks to reproduce a side dish but names neither the ingredients nor the method. Only the later visual evidence shows the citrus being added to the same corn.

task_blueprint.instruction: Could you save a recipe video so I can make this side dish the same way next time?

observed.why: The bowl shows cooked loose corn and seasonings, but the next ingredient is not known. An ordinary loose-kernel side recipe is a reasonable provisional match.
The new batch shows the green citrus being cut, then visibly squeezed into that same bowl at 677.2–678.2 s. A plain recipe without this step does not reproduce the preparation.
